text:
Morgan: Quick postmortem follow-up. Fridays outage produced too many pages; need owners + dates for dedupe, thresholds, and paging policy.
Alex: I can own dedupe for backend CPU. Plan: include trace_id/request_id in dedupe key, extend window to 10m, add cooldown for flapping alerts. PR by Tue EOD.
Lee: I'll run a 90d threshold audit to separate GC/transient spikes from actionable CPU issues. Proposal: page only on >=95% sustained 3m; lower thresholds remain for dashboards. ETA 48h.
Jiayi: I'll update paging policy and runbook (who to page, escalation path infra vs runtime) and add approval step for suppressions. Draft by Thu.
Stella: I'll schedule a weekly 30m "noise sweep" (check unique signatures, pages/hour, flaps). Invite created.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0319 linked; postmortem draft available internally.
Morgan: Recurring pattern noted: cache regen ~02:00-02:20 UTC causing frontend 5xx bursts. Suggested mitigation: stagger warmups, add jitter and throttle parallelism.
Alex: I'll change warmup_parallelism to 2 and add jitter rand(0,300). Test in staging and attach PR.
Lee: For suppression: if same signature >5 times in 30m, mark subsequent alerts internal-only for 1h. I'll add this rule to alert config.
Jiayi: Product signoff required for any user-impacting suppression; internal-only is ok. I'll add approval checkbox in doc.
Stella: Dashboard template coming tomorrow: pages_per_hour, unique_signatures, avg_resolve_time.
Morgan: Action items (AI-201..AI-204) assigned in the postmortem. Please post when done and include AI IDs in the checklist.
Alex: Ack, will post PR link here when ready.
Lee: Historical run started.
Jiayi: Doc in review.
Stella: Noise sweep invite: "eng-oncall Noise Sweep" weekly Wed 09:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation update deploys next Monday.
Morgan: Thanks everyone. We'll recheck after PRs/docs land.
